Yithi: “Kwembulelwe kimi ukuthi iquqaba lamaJini belilalele, lathi: ‘Ngempela sizwe iKurani eyisimanga!’”
Iholela kubuqotho sakholwa kuyo futhi asisoze sabhangqa muntu no Allah.
Nokuthi udumo lweNkosi yethu luphakeme, akanamfazi akanangane.
Lowo owethu oyisiwula bekakhuluma iphutha ngo Allah.
Futhi besicabanga ukuthi Abantu namaJini abasoze bakhuluma amanga ngo Allah.
Nebala amadoda angabantu abecela ukuvikelwa amaJini, bheka ngoba abe esebathusa njalo.
Nabo bebecabanga njengani ukuthi u Allah akasoze avusa muntu ekufeni.
Kuthe lapho siya emkhathini sathola kugcwele abaqaphi kanzima namalangabi.
Kadeni besihlala silalele; kepha manje ozama ukulalela uhlangabezana nelangabi limlindele.
Empeleni nathi asazi, kumbe okubi okuhloselwe abasemhlabeni noma iNkosi yabo ibahlosele okuhle.
Kanti futhi kunabanye bethu abalungile kanti abanye abanjalo, sinezindlela ezahlukene.
Besazi ukuthi asisoze saphunyuka ku Allah emhlabeni futhi singasoze saphunyuka uma simubalekela.
Kuthe uma sizwa inkokhelo sakholwa kuyo, bheka ngoba lowo okholwa eNkosini yakhe akanalo ixhala lokucindezelwa no ukuthelwa ngengcabha.
Kantike kunalabo abangamaMusilimu kithi futhi kunalabo abaphambukile; kepha labo abazinikelayo yibo labo abziqokele ukulunga.
Labo abaphambukile bayokuba izithungelo zeJahanamu.
Ukube babambelela endleleni eqondile besizobapha amanzi ayinala.
Ukuze sibavivinye ngawo; kantike lowo ochitha imiyalo yeNkosi yakhe; iyomufaka esijezisweni esinzima.
AmaMasajidi angawaka Allah, ngakhoke ningakhonzi muntu no Allah.
Kwathi inceku ka Allah imile imkhonza bacishe balakenyana phezu kwakhe.
Yithi: “Ngikhonza iNkosi yami kuphela vo, futhi angiyibhanqi nalutho!”
Yithi: “Okubi nokuhle kini akukho ezandleni zami”
Yithi: “Akekho noyedwa oyongivikela ku Allah futhi akukho la engiyophephela khona ngaphandle kwaKhe!”
Ngiphethe nje umlayezo ovela ku Allah nemiyalelo yaKhe; loyo ongalaleli u Allah neSithunywa saKhe uthola uMlilo weJahanamu, uyobhadla kuwo unaphakade.
Kuyothi lapho bebona lokho abathenjiswe kona; bayokwazi kahle ukuthi ubani obengumsizi obuthaka nonebutho elidlanzana.
Yithi: “Angazi ukuba kuseduze na lokhu enithenjiswe kona kumbe iNkosi yami ikuhlehlisele isikhathi esithize.”
UnguSolwazi wokungabonwa, akambuleli muntu kokungabonwa kwaKhe.
Ngaphandleke kwalowo amqokile njengeSithunywa; bheka ngoba izingqaphi zikanise ngaphambili nangemuva.
Ukuze azi ukuthi bayendlulisile imiyalelo yeNkosi yabo futhi ingamele konke abanakho kanti futhi yazi yonke into ngononina.
